L10: Reset behavior verification.
L10: Register access (read/write to all fields; reserved-bit behavior).
L10: Nominal transfer / transaction across the protocol's operating modes.
L10: Error and fault condition handling.
L10: Back-to-back / sustained operation.
L16: VBUS at 4.40..5.25 V at the downstream port.
L16: Device must assert D+ pull-up (FS) or D- pull-up (LS) within 100 ms of VBUS rising.
L16: NRZI encoding + bit stuffing with insert-zero-after-six-ones rule.
L16: CRC-5 with polynomial x^5+x^2+1 on token / SOF packets.
L16: CRC-16 with polynomial x^16+x^15+x^2+1 on data packets.
L16: PID byte format = PID[3:0] || ~PID[3:0]; receiver checks complement.
L16: SOF token transmitted at start of each (micro)frame; 11-bit frame number; CRC-5 protected.
L16: Endpoint 0 always present + supports the standard device requests (GET_DESCRIPTOR, SET_ADDRESS, SET_CONFIGURATION, etc.)
L16: Data toggle alternates DATA0/DATA1 per ACKed transaction; SETUP forces DATA0; CLEAR_FEATURE(ENDPOINT_HALT) resets toggle
L16: Bus enumeration sequence: GET_DESCRIPTOR(Device) at address 0 → SET_ADDRESS → GET_DESCRIPTOR(Configuration) → SET_CONFIG
L16: Hubs forwarding HS upstream to FS/LS downstream must implement a Transaction Translator and Split transactions.
L16: Bus-powered devices: ≤ 100 mA before SET_CONFIGURATION; ≤ 500 mA after configuration.
L16: Suspended devices: ≤ 500 µA from VBUS.
L16: Reset (SE0) ≥ 10 ms drives device to Default state and address 0.
